text.description_html:
Bommer FM120HD - 120" Standard Full Mortise Continuous Geared Hinge

These 120" long Full Mortise Continuous Gear Hinges are normally used in new construction and are applied as to conceal both hinge leaves. Also used in renovations and the leaves will cover existing standard door hinge preps. Full Mortise Hinge - The frame leaf is fastened to the door frame jamb. Door leaf is fastened to the door edge.

Bommer FM120HD Full Mortise - 120" Continuous Gear Hinges are packaged complete with mounting hardware. All fasteners are #12-24 x 7/16" Type C , FHUC screws that are self threading.

Unlike a conventional hinge, the 10 Foot Continuous Door Hinge has no pin. Also, it is not like a "piano" hinge either, which has 50% of each knuckle cut away, and depends on a thin wire to hold each leaf together.

A Continuous Geared Aluminum hinge consists of two full-height, paired and geared leafs. Each geared leaf rotates evenly from top to bottom, riding on superior Delrin Teflon bearings. The geared leafs and bearings are held together by a full length channel cap. This assembly retains the smooth, clean lines of the door and frame, while easily supporting heavy doors.

Specifications for Bommer FM120HD 10 Foot Continuous Door Hinge

  • Hinge Length: 120"
  • Hinge Material: Aluminum
  • Number of Bearings: 39
  • Maximum Door Weight: 780 lbs. (Heavy Duty)
  • Maximum Door Height: 10' (120")
  • Maximum Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise Continuous Gear Hinge
  • UL Fire Rated
  • Packaged with Installation Hardware
  • Made in the USA
  • BHMA Certified Grade 1
  • Lifetime Guarantee
